crozier_version.description: The version of the `crozier` binary that ran.

searched_paths.description:
The paths searched for crozier configs, as given (the working directory
when none were).

exit_code.description:
The command's exit status: 0 every checked generator matched (or nothing
was checked), 3 at least one mismatched, 4 none mismatched and at least one
could not be checked.

counts.description: How many results have each status.

timing_totals.description: Timing summed over the generators where both sides ran.

results.description: One result per generator, or per config that could not be read.

Counts.description: How many results have each status.

matched.description: Generators whose output matched the reference.

mismatched.description: Generators whose output differed from the reference.

could_not_check.description: Generators (or configs) that could not be checked.

TimingTotals.description:
Run totals over the generators where both the reference command and crozier
ran.

generators_timed.description: How many generators the totals cover.

reference_seconds.description: Summed wall time of the reference commands, in seconds.

crozier_seconds.description: Summed wall time of crozier's generation, in seconds.

speedup.description: `reference_seconds / crozier_seconds`; null when nothing was timed.

GeneratorResult.description: One generator's result (or one unreadable config's, with `generator` null).

config_file.description: The crozier config file the generator is declared in.

generator.description: The generator's name; null when the config itself could not be read.

spec.description: The resolved OpenAPI document; null when it could not be resolved.

reference.description: The reference command and how it ended; null when none was resolved.

exit_code.description: Its exit status; null when it did not run or ended without one.

diagnostic.description:
The command's own diagnostic (the tail of its stderr) when it failed or
left no usable reference; null otherwise.

comparison.description: The comparison of the two trees; null when no comparison was made.

layout.description: The layout crozier generated its side with.

files_compared.description: How many distinct paths the two trees hold between them.

differing.description: Paths on both sides whose normalized contents differ.

diff_file.description:
The `--diff-dir` file holding this mismatch's normalized diff; null
otherwise.

timing.description:
The two measurements and the figures derived from them; null when
nothing ran.

reference_seconds.description: Wall time of the generator's one reference-command invocation, in seconds.

crozier_seconds.description:
Wall time of crozier's generation for the generator, in seconds (the
comparison excluded).

speedup.description: `reference_seconds / crozier_seconds`; null unless both sides ran.

saved_seconds.description: `reference_seconds - crozier_seconds`; null unless both sides ran.

reason.description: Why the generator could not be checked; null otherwise.

oneOf.description: crozier's whole output tree matched the whole reference tree.
At least one file differed or was on only one side.
The comparison could not be made; `reason` says why.

ComparedLayout.description: The layout a comparison generated crozier's side with.
